answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reduced by each unverified claim, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Each submission hangs on the ledge of a task receipt, and the sparrow is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the prism of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
